headline: Bank of Japan Holds Interest Rate at 1.25% While Signaling December Hike
summary: The Bank of Japan maintained its benchmark interest rate at 1.25%, while signaling that a further rate increase could take place as early as December to keep inflation near its 2% target.
why: Central bank monetary policy decisions and interest rate guidance directly influence government bond yields, currency valuations, and domestic borrowing costs.

impacts.name: Japan
impacts.why: Maintaining interest rates while hinting at future hikes affects domestic yields and currency strength.
